svg.text: Reads Sales. Runs again when Sales changes,
including rows added below the table.
Read-only: it cannot change any cell.
Stops after 1 s; at most 100,000 result rows.
Fills Report!A3:B7. Cells in the result can't be typed over.
Mock 4 · SQL(): editor, schema and the spilled result
The formula cell is the top-left of the result, like Excel's spill. The result is a table: SalesByRegion, with a header.
The schema sidebar is the named ranges with their fields and purposes; click inserts the name, quoted where needed.
Long queries are edited here, not in the formula bar. The formula bar still shows the formula text.
The result name is optional; it defaults to a name made from the first table (editable here).
